blocks.raw: <Tip>**Five essential quality control processes:** (1) design reviews by senior staff; (2) code compliance checklists; (3) consultant coordination reviews (MEP, structural, landscape); (4) final document review before issuance; (5) constructability review with contractor input. These catch errors before they reach the client or contractor.</Tip>
